OPTIONS: only the endpoints are labelled anywhere -- ES2998 VALUE LABELS for P101-P110 carry only 98 'N.S.' 99 'N.C.'; the stem says 0 = 'muy mal', 10 = 'muy bien'; TARJETA 'A' prints 'MUY MAL' over 00 and 'MUY BIEN' over 10 with 01-09 bare numerals. Shipped 'Muy mal' (resp 0) / 'Muy bien' (resp 10) in sentence case (the stem's lowercase wording capitalised; the card is all caps), resp 1-9 have option rows with option_text blank (not padded). 0 is a valid scale point per the .do and the card. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Valuation of professions including military occupations' and the .do header ('0-10 valuation of ten professions including career soldier and professional soldier') both describe P.1; 10 items and resp 0..10 match. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation (CIS publishes Estudio 2998 in Spanish only; English written by IRW, issues-page line owed once live). Questionnaire P.21, P.22, P.23 (columns 110, 111, 112). Processing script data/spain_2013_defense.do, Bookmark 7: resources. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels, derivation core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2013_defense.do infixes DA2998 with the CIS variable names lower-cased (p21 110, p22 111, p23 112, matching ES2998's DATA LIST 'P21 110 P22 111 P23 112' and the questionnaire's column markers (110)-(112)), and Bookmark 7 keeps those names as item, so the IRW item code IS the CIS variable name; nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. ES2998 VARIABLE LABELS are terse summaries, not the question: P21 'Valoración del volumen de efectivos en las Fuerzas Armadas', P22 'Valoración de los medios técnicos y materiales de las Fuerzas Armadas españolas', P23 'Valoración del presupuesto anual destinado a la defensa nacional y las Fuerzas Armadas' -- they pin the mapping only (each names the one referent of the matching questionnaire question: troops / technical and material means / budget). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = cues2998.pdf P.21, P.22, P.23 full question wording verbatim (pdftotext -raw, line wraps joined, no hyphen breaks present; asserted in .cache/spain_2013_defense_resources/build.R), shipped over the abbreviated labels per the CIS sibling convention. P.21 prints 'resulta excesivo, el adecuado o insuficiente' (with the article 'el') and is shipped literally. Each is a self-standing question, so instructions and section_prompt are blank; single trivial section_id. No interviewer directions appear in these three questions. OPTIONS: 1/2/3 = Excesivo/Adecuado/Insuficiente for p21 and p23, Excesivos/Adecuados/Insuficientes (plural, agreeing with 'medios') for p22 -- the ES2998 VALUE LABELS and the printed questionnaire options agree exactly for all 3 items, both in order and in code; 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' dropped by the .do. All levels labelled, no blank option_text. REBUILD: re-ran the .do Bookmark 7 logic on DA2998 (2479 records, width 312; id = row number; cov_sex col 185, cov_age cols 186-187 with 99 -> missing; 8/9 -> missing) and reproduced the live table exactly: 5182 rows both, 2097 ids both, 0 only-live, 0 only-rebuilt, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches, cov_sex stored as Stata value label (Hombre 2841 / Mujer 2341 rows, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/3): p21 406/923/407, p22 301/874/530, p23 768/605/368 -- every item uses all three levels. Dropped as 8/9: p21 739/4, p22 766/8, p23 729/9 (roughly 30% N.S. per item). No filter on P.21-P.23 (asked of all respondents). STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Adequacy of troops, means and budget of the armed forces' and the .do header ('whether the number of troops, the technical means and the defence budget are excessive, adequate or insufficient') both describe P.21-P.23; 3 items and resp 1..3 match. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation (CIS publishes Estudio 2998 in Spanish only; English written by IRW, issues-page entry owed once live). 'el adecuado' rendered 'the adequate amount'; 'medios técnicos y materiales' rendered 'technical and material resources'. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (3 items, resp 1..3).
